$comment: Scripted days for Sarah. `state` selects the persona's calm base or its crash delta using the same deep-merge golden.yaml and the CLI already use. `patch` is a snapshot-shaped override, identical in shape to golden.yaml's `overrides`. `client` is the seam that keeps the engine pure — permissions and user responses live there, are consumed ONLY by the app-state derivation, and never reach decide(). `pins` links a day to the golden fixture that already asserts the engine behaviour, so this file never restates a golden assertion.

days.label: Cold start — three weeks of history, not enough to trust a baseline
Luteal crash — sympathetic overload on top of the luteal phase
Follicular day 10 — the engine PERMITS the planned intensity
HRV did not sync — rule 1.1 is unevaluable, not false
Declined — she read the substitution and said no
Cycle tracking off — the ONLY way Sarah reaches in balance
days.$note: With cycle tracking ON she can never be calm: Layer 2 covers days 1-28 with no gaps and calm requires only-always-on-L3-fired. The other route to calm, cycle_day 31 (F13), is deliberately not used — it produces 'in balance today' while her whole hormonal layer silently did not evaluate. See app-states.json.
